start.title: How do I get started?
start.body: You can explore every module without a real sign-in. Onboarding simulates five setup steps. That draft is independent of the sample business data: it does not create real stores or agents and does not replace the demo collections.

messages.title: Are messages sent to WhatsApp?
messages.body: No. In Conversations you can search customers, change status and assignment, and add local messages. There is no external sending or AI response. Reopen a closed conversation to write. Dates are displayed in UTC.

agent.title: How does the agent preview work?
agent.body: The preview shows the name, tone and greeting you are editing. Saving keeps the configuration in memory while you navigate; it does not call an AI model or automate conversations.

catalog.title: Can I edit the catalog?
catalog.body: Yes. In the “With data” scenario you can create, edit and delete products, search by name or reference and filter by availability. References must be unique. Products included in orders cannot be deleted: deactivate them to retain history. There are no automatic inventory adjustments.

orders.title: What do the metrics and statuses mean?
orders.body: Revenue and average order value only include paid and shipped orders. Pending and cancelled orders do not generate revenue. Periods end on June 14, 2026, a fixed date to make the demo reproducible. Statuses can be changed freely; no payments or shipments are processed.

privacy.title: Where is the data stored?
privacy.body: Business data, messages and the demo profile are kept in browser memory; they are not sent to the backend or third parties. Do not use real data. They are cleared on reload, sign-out or switching profiles. Only the theme persists locally; the sidebar resets to expanded on reload. There is no real multi-tenant isolation.

stores.title: Do currencies and time zones convert data?
stores.body: No. They are fictional preferences for each store. The catalog and all orders use PEN, and reports use UTC. Stores have no independent inventory or real connections. Changing a preference does not alter history.

reset.title: How do I explore empty and error states?
reset.body: Use the “Scenario” selector above each module. “Empty collections” hides collections and makes configuration read-only. “Read error” shows a simulated failure; “Retry” will keep failing until you switch to “With data”. Switching scenarios discards open drafts but keeps saved changes. “Reset demo” restores all business data and discards drafts; it does not affect onboarding.
